Name: Custom Tracker
Author: EscaMMC
Description:
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*][b]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/b][/*]
[*][b]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/b][/*]
[*][b]Download CustomTracker[/b] from the Files tab above, the [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/CustomTracker/releases]GitHub Releases page[/url], or [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/706059-custom-tracker]ModDrop[/url].[/*]
[*][b]Unzip CustomTracker[/b] into your [i]Stardew Valley\Mods[/i] folder.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b]Customization[/b][/size]

By default, Custom Tracker will hide the original tracker icon and replace it with a large yellow arrow.

The mod can also be customized to enable tracking without having the "Tracker" profession, track additional forage types (including spring onions and berry/walnut bushes), display the specific forage being tracked on each icon, and more.

To edit the tracker icons or change this mod's settings, please see the [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/CustomTracker]readme file on GitHub[/url].
[line]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

Custom Tracker should not conflict with any known mods. However, mods that edit the original tracker's appearance may cause it to reappear.

This mod can be used in multiplayer. The custom tracker will only be visible to players who have the mod, and it will use their personal settings.

It also supports spacechase0's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (GMCM). Go to Stardew's main menu, click the gear icon, and select Custom Tracker to change this mod's settings.
[line]
[b][size=4]Translation[/size][/b]

Custom Tracker supports translation of its [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] options menu.

The mod will load a file from the [i]CustomTracker/i18n[/i] folder that matches the current language code. If no matching translation exists, it will use [i]default.json[/i].

See the Stardew Valley Wiki's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]Modding:Translations[/url] page for more information. Please feel free to submit translation files through GitHub, Nexus Mods, ModDrop, or Discord.

The mod currently includes these translations:

[url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/CustomTracker/blob/master/CustomTracker/i18n/default.json]English[/url]
